reviews.text:
I hired Greg to build my custom pool in Preston Hollow in May of 2022. Initially he was very response and quickly sent me an estimate based on plans that my landscape architect drew. The agreement was cost plus and as we got into construction it became apparent that the estimate was more of a guess. Upon completion we were well over the initial estimate. Greg was also rarely present during construction other than to pick up checks. One specific item to note is that prior to concrete we were supposed to do a thorough walk-through to go over all pipe/light placement. Greg was unavailable, but said his guys already walked through and everything was correct. This has since proved to be an issue and will require us to drain the pool in the fall to properly install a piece of equipment. The plans also showed a large bench and stairs that were not initially formed during rebar. After I repeatedly questioned the structure of the rebar, Greg noticed the discrepancy and had it re-formed per the plan, the cost of which he tried to pass along to me.

After final payment in March 2023, multiple leaks and tile issues were also found. Greg has been slow to address these issues, and to date, they have not all been resolved.
reviews.author: Tony Delaune

reviews.text: We recently bought a home that had a pool built by Greg and could not be happier with the level of service. Would highly recommend using him.
